data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Ioanna, derived from the Hebrew word Yohev, meaning 'God is gracious'. In the New Testament, John the Baptist's mother was named Johanna. This name was also borne by several early Christian saints. The name Jeanna carries the meaning “God is gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
